USES FIXED SET 1!!! CHECK SLIDE 6

You will either be a helper, or a tower soaker
You will share this responsibility with your partner (see slide 3)
This swaps throughout the mechanic, so a helper will go in tower at some point

Towers are soaked in the order of AAABBBBA
Means first in tower players are Group A and take towers 1 2 3 and 8
Means first helper are Group B take towers 4 5 6 7

Ranged will have non-adjust positions

Melees adjust for their ranged partner

The Phase starts 
with a shared
tankbuster
(or invuln)

Three kinds of 
symbols appear
over the players 
after the raidwide

3 cones on one role
3 circles on the other

After the Tankbuster, you 
want to gather up in pairs:

MT + H1
OT + H2
M1 + R1
M2 + R2

Supports are west
DPS are east

Your partner will stay the
same throughout the 
entire mechanic

Towers 1 3 5 7 will
always be 2 stacks
1 circle 1 cone

Towers 2 4 6 8 will
always be 2 circle 
and 2 cones

First set of helpers
need to remember their
shape all the way to
Tower 4 (First B Set)

Towers will be taken by
the buddy pair
with stack marker first

These pairs will take the
A Towers (1, 2, 3, 8)

The buddies with the
same debuff will be
helpers first

These pairs will take the
B Towers (4, 5, 6, 7)

These can spawn anywhere,
but will always be in a 90°
angle next to each other

After one tower set resolves,
they rotate cw or ccw by 45°
This is random

The towers that spawn,will
be the new relative south

If you look at the boss, 
the leftmost tower will always
be the cone tower

the rightmost tower will always
be the circle tower

At the same time, two
sets of towers will spawn

For the sake of visual
clarity, every tower 
set will still be displayed
around the C marker

The stack player should always
be max melee on the left side of
the tower

The circle player should be on the
eastmost position of the tower

The stack player should always
be between the inner light
beam and the boss hitbox

The cone player should always
be at southmost tower position,
slightly shifted towards the right
side

Support stack is west
DPS stack is east

melees adjust for their
ranged partners as
necessary

The helper positions
are always fixed

If you are a helper
in an odd set,
this is where you 
need to go

Same as the cone tower player, the 
cone tower helper will be southmost
of the tower, slightly shifted to the right

the dps helper pair in odd sets
will always between both towers,
close to the circle tower and max
melee

Tank helper stand in hitbox close to
tower between boss center 
and tower

With the positions stated
on previous slides,
everything should resolve 
without any problems.

Stacks are soaked by
3 players each stack

Cone is baited by a
non-stack player

Circle is away from every
other player

New towers will
spawn 45° away from 
the last ones

As stated before, the 
direction they shift to
is random

They will be treated as
new south again, repeat
this idea every time.

Before moving, ranged players wait 
a second so the melee player can 
spot the debuff to adjust for
the next set

Tower players will get a new debuff
after the tower has been played
Melees will look at their ranged 
buddy to determine their position
for the next set.

In even sets (2,4,6,8) 
Towers will have:

1x cone in front 
1x circle in back

position to resolve this
are very precise so
helpers don't die.

It's visually hard to have the
towers be accurate on the slides.
This is what it should look like
ingame. The towers overlap
the bosses hitbox. 
As a front cone player, make sure
you are on the spot inside the tower,
where his inner hitbox ring and the 
edge of the towers connect.

The circle player wants to be on the
exact opposite side to the cone player
This guarantees maximum distance
so the cone gets baited by the helper

During set 2 resolution, Kefka shoots
out 4 clones to the closest players.

These spawn directly from inside of
him and charge in the direction of
the 4 closest players and put an AOE
around those players.

To properly position them as centered
as possible, we already said in the
previous slide, that the cone tower 
players should be on the inner hitbox
ring line.

The north players should be directly
on his outer hitbox ring NE / NW of 
the new relative south (the towers).

This will guarantee that the clones
spawn as close to the middle 
as possible.

BIG BOX
MARKERS ARE
NOT MADE
FOR FORSAKEN.
PLEASE DO NOT
USE THE MARKERS
FOR POSITIONING.

The angle can also be created
like so:

A top-down camera view
is very helpful in seeing this.

You're aiming to create a 90 degree
angle or T-shape from the 
player with the cone
in the tower:

After the even set, markers swap back
to the odd markers.

This means it's back to 2 stacks, 1 cone
and one circle.

Here as a ranged, you can just move 
to the Futures End / Pasts End spot.

Make sure to just be visible to the melee
so they can adjust for the next set.

And again, towers rotate by 45°.

During the execution of this set,
the Boss will cast Futures or Pasts End.

There are casts, that will do a baited
halfroom cleave before the next set.

So after you planted yourself on your 
spot, read his cast and remember it
after the towers resolve.

During the execution of this set,
the Boss will cast Futures or Pasts End.

There are casts, that will do a baited
halfroom cleave before the next set.

So after you planted yourself on your 
spot, read his cast and remember it
after the towers resolve.
Post even towers Futures / Past End

This repeats after 
every even set
(i.e. Set 2, 4, 6, 8)

You not only get new debuffs, you also
have to position yourself now 
either between the new towers that
spawn or on the opposite side.

Futures End / Pasts End will cast
 a baited halfroom cleave either 
in front or behind him and all of his
clones.

For clarification: 
Futures End will cleave his front
Pasts End will cleave his back 

therefor:

Futures End is opposite of the tower 
(new relative north)

Pasts End is between the towers
(new relative south)

He will execute this during the next odd
set by casting "All Things End"

Make sure to stand max melee to propperly 
bait the clones /bosses cleaves

H2 always left with stack
 
R1 forced cone side

M1 didnt share stack 
with R1 partner, so dps side.

OT circle position

Now its time to swap
helpers and in tower player

Set 4 is start of Group B

Group A needs to 
remember their shape &
side for Tower 8

After the even set, markers swap back
to the odd markers.

This means it's back to 2 stacks, 1 cone
and one circle.

Here as a ranged, you can just move 
to the Futures End / Pasts End spot.

Make sure to just be visible to the melee
so they can adjust for the next set.

And again, towers rotate by 45°.

Roles are FIXED in tower
H+M in left
R+T in right
Obviously remember if
you were circle or cone
from start.

Previous Tower players
become Helpers and
Previous Helpers
become Tower Players
otherwise solved exactly
like Set 2.

the Boss will cast Futures or Pasts End.

There are casts, that will do a baited
halfroom cleave before the next set.

So after you planted yourself on your 
spot, read his cast and remember it
after the towers resolve.

Previous Tower players
become Helpers and
Previous Helpers
become Tower Players
otherwise solved exactly
like Set 2.

Roles are FIXED in tower
H+M in left
R+T in right
This is enforced because
of the initial pairs being
both the same on roles

Here as a ranged, you can just move 
to the Futures End / Pasts End spot.

Make sure to just be visible to the melee
so they can adjust for the next set.

Tower M+T check your role partner.
Check if you both have stack. If you do,
you will be on other role side for next set
to fix the pattern.

And again, towers rotate by 45°.

During the execution of this set,
the Boss will cast Futures or Pasts End.

There are casts, that will do a baited
halfroom cleave before the next set.

So after you planted yourself on your 
spot, read his cast and remember it
after the towers resolve.

M2 goes to Support Tower
since he had same as 
Ranged. 

Cone and Circle 
players forced like before.

These sets repeat as 2-3 did before but with
opposite people in towers.
The first tower players continue go to FIXED positions
like the helpers did in earlier sets.

The first helper players continue to be tower players
Melee/Tank make sure you look out for adjusts
between sets if you have 2x the same! You will
keep towering until your stacks hit 0

Swap to Group A
after. 

Helpers back in Tower

In Tower Player back 
as helpers

People who started
out as helpers, your
stacks should hit 0
now. No more taking
towers, and no more
getting new mechanics
but you still have to
help out the others one
last time.

It's time to use the
last mechanics that 
the tower players got in 
Set 3. 
If you started as a
helper, you're helping 
one last time, and if 
you started as a tower
you are going in there 
one last time. You gotta
remember which side
you need to go on too!

Also bait last All Things
Ending by running to
A Marker (no matter
where it is in your strat)
then stay for past, or
cross over for future.

During the execution of this set,
the Boss will cast Futures or Pasts End.

There are casts, that will do a baited
halfroom cleave before the next set.

So after you planted yourself on your 
spot, read his cast and remember it
after the towers resolve.
